በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
በስብሐት: ስብሐት — in glory, in praise (በ- + noun)
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
ተነበዩ: ተነበየ — they prophesied (3mp perfect, tä-stem, n-b-y)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
በጽሐ: በጽሐ — he reached, arrived (3ms perfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ) · with ይእቲ as apparent subject, 'it reached' her bearing, 'her time came' (ወይእቲኒ በጽሐ ወሊዶታ), a 3ms form where 3fs በጽሐት is expected (?)
ሠረቀ: ሠረቀ — it rose, dawned (3ms perfect, G, of sun and light) · as a noun in construct, 'the rising of, sunrise of' (እስከ ሠረቀ ህንድ 'to the sunrise of India') (?) · of a month, 'began' (አመ ሠረቀ ቀዳሚ ወርኅ 'on the day the first month began')
ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ስብሐተ: ስብሐት — praise, hymn (noun f., accusative; construct 'praise of')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
በውስቴትኪ: ውስተ — in your midst, within you (በ- + ውስቴት- + -ኪ '2fs you')
በጽዮን: ጽዮን — by Zion (በ- + proper name, after ተማሕፀነ 'adjure by') · in Zion (በ- 'in' + proper name: ያስተርኢ አምላከ አማልክት በጽዮን 'the God of gods will appear in Zion')
በዕለተ: ዕለት — on the day of (በ- + noun, construct 'day-of')
ለእስራኤል: እስራኤል — to Israel, O Israel (ለ- + proper name) · over Israel (ይነግሥ ለእስራኤል 'he shall reign over Israel') · marking the object after ወአኅለፎሙ 'and he made them pass, Israel' · ለ- marking the possessor after a noun (እከዮሙ ለእስራኤል 'their evil, (that) of Israel')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ለወለተ: ወለት — of the daughter of (ለ- 'of, for' + noun, fem., construct 'daughter of') · ወለት — marking the object, doubled by the verbal suffix (ወአፍቀራ ለወለተ ፈርዖን 'and he loved the daughter of Pharaoh'; also in apposition to ምስሌሃ, 'with her, the daughter of Pharaoh')
ን: እብን — -ን, second half of በአእባን 'with stones', split off by a stray wordspace · also the first half of ን ፡ ገስስ 'we touch' (ንገስስ), split by a stray wordspace (the second half is ገስስ)
ቅድመ: ቅድመ — before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back')
ቡሩክ: ቡሩክ — blessed (adjective, passive participle of ባረከ)
ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
በስመ: ስም — by the name of (በ- 'by, in' + construct 'name of')
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
እደዊከ: እድ — your hands (noun, plural እደው, stem እደዊ- + -ከ '2ms your')
ወይሰግዲ: ሰገደ — and they bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, s-g-d, written with final -ዲ)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
ይረክብ: ረከበ — he finds, may find (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, G, r-k-b)
ለአሕዛብ: ሕዝብ — to the nations (ለ- + plural አሕዛብ) · 'of the nations', ለ- genitive naming the owner after the anticipating -ሆሙ (አማልክቲሆሙ ለአሕዛብ 'the gods of the nations')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ባረኮ: ባረከ — he blessed him (3ms perfect, b-r-k + -ኦ 'him')
ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ህሎ: ሀለወ — he/it was, existed (3ms perfect, spelling variant ህሎ of ሀሎ)
ዘይወፅእ: ወጽአ — who comes out (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
እምኔከ: እም — from you (preposition እም with suffix -ኔከ '2ms')
ምዕራፊሁ: ምዕራፍ — his resting-place (?) (noun, from ዐረፈ 'rest', + -ሁ '3ms his') (?)
ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
መድኀኔ: መድኀኒ — saviour of (noun, construct; መድኀኔ ዓለም 'Savior of the world')
ለክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — of Christ, Christ's (ለ- naming the possessor after an anticipating suffix) · ለ- marking the object, doubled by the suffix on ወያመስልዎ ('they liken Christ')
ወይብልዎ: ብህለ — and they say to him (ወ- + 3mp imperfect ይብሉ + -ሎ '3ms to him', joined as ዎ)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
አሚረ: አሚር — day (noun, accusative; ኵሎ አሚረ 'all day')
ይወርድ: ወረደ — it will descend (3ms imperfect, G, w-r-d)
ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
ወሊቃነ: ሊቅ — and chiefs of (ወ- + plural construct ሊቃነ)
ይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — he/it rises, is lifted (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, l-ʿ-l)
ፈድፋደ: ፈድፋደ — exceedingly, greatly (adverb) · 'especially' before a numeral (ፈድፋደ ፯ እምኔሆሙ 'especially seven of them') (?)
እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
ወይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — and may he be exalted (ወ- + 3ms jussive, tä-stem, root l-ʿ-l 'be high') · and it will be exalted, with a thing as subject (ወይትሌዐል ክብርከ 'and your glory will be exalted')
ይተረጐም: ተርጐመ — it is interpreted (3ms imperfect ይተረጐም, passive/reflexive ተ-stem)
መላኬ: መላኪ — ruler, lord of (noun, construct; Dillmann's መላኪ) (?)
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ይስዕር: ሰዐረ — he abolishes, destroys (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, G, s-ʿ-r; the construction after ፈቀደ is hard) (?)
ወለዘፈቀደ: ዘ — and to whom he wished (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' + relative ዘ- + 3ms perfect ፈቀደ 'wished')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ዘተብህለ: ተብህለ — which was said (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect passive of ብህለ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ወረሰየ: ረሰየ — and he made, set (ወ- + 3ms perfect, r-s-y)
ወዘንተኒ: ዝንቱ — and this also (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ + enclitic -ኒ)
አኃዜ: አኀዘ — holder, seizer of (construct of agent noun አኃዚ, ʾ-ḫ-z; 'holder-of') (?)
ተቀነወ: ተቀነወ — he was nailed, pierced (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ቀነወ 'pierce, nail'; compare ቅንዋት 'nails')
እራኁ: እራኁ — unresolved (?) (form unknown; follows ተቀነወ as if an accusative of the part nailed, perhaps with -ሁ 'his') (?)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
